references.text: God's direct answer to Abraham's prayer: He has heard him concerning Ishmael and will bless him, make him fruitful, and multiply him into a great nation.
God assures Abraham that Ishmael, his son with Hagar, will also become a great nation.
The angel of the Lord promised Hagar that her descendants through Ishmael would be countless, and prophesied about Ishmael's character and future.
God encourages Hagar regarding Ishmael's future and assures her that He will make him into a great nation.
Paul uses the story of Ishmael and Isaac to illustrate the difference between those born according to the flesh and those born according to the promise.
16:11 establishes the promise concerning Ishmael's life, while 17:18 shows Abraham's fear that this promise might be broken, highlighting God's faithfulness in His response.
